preview.summary: Neutral, crisp, and highly legible B2B SaaS.

semanticColorUsage.background: The page canvas behind every surface.
semanticColorUsage.foreground: Primary text and high emphasis symbols.
semanticColorUsage.card: Grouped content and raised working surfaces.
semanticColorUsage.muted: Subdued regions, secondary controls, and quiet fills.
semanticColorUsage.border: Separators, control outlines, and structural rules.
semanticColorUsage.primary: Primary actions, selection, and active emphasis.
semanticColorUsage.primaryForeground: Content placed on the primary color.
semanticColorUsage.warning: Caution that needs attention without blocking work.
semanticColorUsage.ring: Keyboard focus indication around interactive controls.

display.usage: Singular page statements and expressive product moments.

heading.usage: Section hierarchy and important grouped content.

body.usage: Reading text, explanations, and form guidance.

label.usage: Compact labels, metadata, and interface wayfinding.

code.usage: Commands, values, identifiers, and technical evidence.

3.usage: Compact control internals and paired labels.

12.usage: Major sections and page level separation.

16.usage: Largest page sections and major composition breaks.

layout.guidance: Constrain reading width, align surfaces to shared columns, and let empty space preserve hierarchy.

mobile.guidance: Use one content column and preserve source order.

tablet.guidance: Introduce paired regions only when each remains independently readable.

desktop.guidance: Use the full grid while keeping reading lines constrained.

zoom.guidance: Allow controls and content to wrap without clipping or overlap.

reflow.guidance: Retain every action and meaning in a single logical flow.

control.usage: Buttons, fields, and compact interactive surfaces.

panel.usage: Cards, panels, and larger grouped regions.

strong.usage: Selected, focused, or strongly separated regions.

flat.usage: Default surfaces separated by spacing or borders.

overlay.usage: Dialogs, menus, and content above the working plane.

buttons.guidance: Use one clear primary action and quiet secondary actions with stable geometry.

states.default: Preserve a clear fill and readable action label.
states.hover: Increase emphasis without changing size or position.
states.focus: Show the semantic focus ring outside the control edge.
states.active: Use a restrained pressed treatment without moving nearby content.
states.disabled: Keep the label readable while removing action affordance.
states.loading: Retain the action label and add an explicit busy indicator.
states.success: Confirm completion with text and the success role.
states.error: Name the failed action with text and the destructive role.

links.guidance: Keep destination language specific and preserve the underline as a noncolor cue.

states.default: Underline actionable text and use the primary role.
states.hover: Strengthen the underline without shifting the line.
states.focus: Use the same visible focus ring as other controls.
states.active: Retain the destination name while showing activation.
states.disabled: Render unavailable destinations as text, not links.
states.loading: Expose busy status without replacing the destination name.
states.success: Confirm a completed local action in adjacent text.
states.error: Describe the local failure without relying on color.

forms.guidance: Keep labels visible, help persistent, and validation adjacent to the affected field.
forms.help: Use a work address so the confirmation has a clear destination.

inputs.textareaPlaceholder: Describe the interface direction to preserve.
inputs.guidance: Align field edges, keep labels above values, and reserve space for help and validation.

cards.title: Release readiness
cards.description: A balanced summary of the evidence needed before publication.
cards.guidance: Group one topic per card with a stable title, summary, evidence, and action hierarchy.

panels.title: Publication checklist
panels.description: Related checks remain visible as one bounded working region.
panels.guidance: Use panels for durable context and align related rows to a shared grid.

navigation.label: Release sections
navigation.guidance: Mark the current location in text and structure, and preserve logical keyboard order.

dataDisplay.tableCaption: Publication readiness by Design System Release

listItems.title: Evaluation
listItems.description: Keyboard, reflow, and both themes are covered.

dataDisplay.guidance: Use quiet alignment, clear row headings, and stable columns for structured product data.
dataDisplay.overflowGuidance: Keep the table intact inside a labelled horizontal scroll region when columns do not fit.

badges.label: In review
badges.meaning: A maintainer is checking the release

alerts.title: Evaluation complete
alerts.description: All automated checks and required reviews passed.

alerts.title: Publication blocked
alerts.description: Resolve the missing accessibility evidence before continuing.

states.empty: No releases have been proposed yet.
states.filteredEmpty: No releases match the active filters.
states.error: Release evidence could not be read. Try again locally.
states.success: Release evidence is complete and ready for review.
states.disabled: Publication is unavailable until every review passes.
states.destructive: Removing this candidate discards its local evaluation record.

feedback.guidance: Place status beside the object it describes and keep recovery information in the same reading path.
feedback.nonColorGuidance: Pair every tone with a plain language label, symbol, or structural treatment.

dialogs.title: Review release evidence
dialogs.description: Inspect the local summary before returning to the publication checklist.
dialogs.guidance: Name the dialog, describe its purpose, and keep actions in a predictable order.
dialogs.escapeBehavior: Escape closes the review dialog because no irreversible work is in progress.
dialogs.focusRestoration: Return focus to the control that opened the dialog.

destructiveActions.consequence: Its local evaluation record and review progress will be removed.
destructiveActions.recoverability: This specimen is reversible and changes only local component state.
destructiveActions.guidance: Repeat the affected object in the confirmation and state both consequence and recoverability before the action.

changelog.summary: Initial Published Design System with complete cross-surface guidance, semantic informational-state tokens, and responsive pagination direction.
